records.title: Походный стол
records.subject: A compact expedition preparation table, 1.6 m wide and 0.85 m deep, height 0.85 m. Heavy dark honey timber trestle legs, broad plank top reinforced at corners with dull iron. One LARGE light cream map covers the central two thirds of the top: just a few thick muted coast/route lines and a simple dot, absolutely NO writing or symbols. Beside the map one simple brass compass without letters, one rolled parchment secured by a leather strap, and two small corked opaque coloured flasks in a low two-hole wooden holder near the far corner. A single empty lower shelf. Tabletop fully exposed, no roof/canopy, no tall racks, no hanging lantern. The map must be the clearest focal surface at 48-degree camp view.
records.prompt: Edit this exact expedition table. Erase ONLY all printed map geography on the large central parchment sheet: remove the islands, water, mountains, forests and any route marks, leaving an entirely BLANK plain warm-cream parchment surface with the existing edges and folds. Keep the big parchment sheet lying flat on the tabletop, with clearly exposed broad central area for a separate map texture overlay. Preserve the table, compass, rolled map, bottle holder, two bottles, camera, wood/metal materials and hand-painted style exactly. Do not put a map into any other place. True transparent alpha background; no backdrop, glow, haze, cast shadow, floor, text or symbols. Whole object visible.

records.title: Карта мира — плоская текстура
records.prompt: Create a standalone FLAT WORLD MAP TEXTURE from the attached owned world geography. This is NOT a 3D object or scene: strictly TOP-DOWN orthographic flat 2D map, ZERO perspective or foreshortening. Preserve the original coastline outlines, relative sizes and positions of the landmasses as closely as possible: huge western continent with northern snowy mountains, western forest belt, southwest broad mountains and southeast marshes; smaller eastern continent with northern mountains and volcanoes along its eastern side; southern/southeastern small Verano archipelago. Retain river routes and main terrain placement. DELETE every flag, flagpole, heraldic icon, city flag, place name, all writing and ornate outer decorations. Simplify dense town/road detail to large readable painterly terrain marks. The illustration is printed on ONE flat light warm-cream parchment sheet, approximately 4:3 rectangle with restrained slightly irregular worn edge, no rolls or curled corners. Muted olive/grey green land, dusty subdued blue water, broad painted grey mountain marks, consistent hand-painted game prop palette. Sheet opaque, outside perimeter true alpha transparency. Whole rectangular sheet visible with narrow empty transparent margin. No desk, props, border symbols, compass rose, shadow, light source, floating island relief or physical raised mountains. Image solely for a planar texture laid over a camp table.
